def process(noaa_data) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = noaa_data.copy()
    df['Year'] = (df['Date'] // 100).astype(int)
    annual = df.groupby('Year')['Number of Fires'].sum().reset_index()
    annual.columns = ['Year', 'NOAA_Fires']
    return annual[annual['Year'] >= 2000]
